Ghaziabad student dies after falling from 15th floor

A 16-year-old girl died after falling from the 15th floor of a building in Ghaziabad's Gaur Siddhartham Society. She was taken to the hospital in critical condition, where she was declared dead. Police found a note at the scene indicating she could not handle academic pressure. Vijayanagar police have begun an investigation.
